title: crumbkit/failure/v1
description: The document that a command prints on standard output when it fails with --json.

alternatives.description: Other repairs the caller can try, in order of preference, each in the shape of recovery. It is present only when the failure offers at least one.

items.description: A repair the caller can try instead, tagged by kind.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
Run the same command again later.
There is no next step, for this reason.

cause.description: The errors that led to the failure, joined with ": ". It is present only when the failure has a cause.

code.description: The failure's stable code in the tool's spelling, such as shelf::books::not_found. It is one or more printable ASCII characters without spaces, from ! to ~.

fields.description: The values at fault, in the order the failure gives them, each under a name of one or more lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscores. A value is a string, an integer, a boolean, null, or an array or object of such values, and an object holds each key once. It is present only when the failure names at least one.

labels.description: The places in a source, such as a file, that the failure points at, in the order the failure gives them. It is present only when the failure has at least one label.

column.description: The 1-based column of the start of the span, counted in characters of its line. It is present only when the span could be read.

excerpt.description: The lines of the source that the span covers, with one line before and one after where the source has them. It is present only when the span could be read.

line.description: The 1-based number of the first line of the excerpt.

text.description: The lines, joined by the line breaks of the source, without a line break at the end.

length.description: The length of the span in bytes.

line.description: The 1-based line that holds the start of the span. It is present only when the span could be read.

name.description: The name of the source, such as a file name. It is present only when the span could be read and the source has a name.

offset.description: The byte offset of the start of the span from the start of the source.

text.description: What the label says about the span. It is present only when the label has text.

recovery.description: What the caller can do next, tagged by kind.

oneOf.description: Run this command. With `all`, run it once with every value of the failure's field that `all` names in place of the argument's placeholder, such as `<ID>...`.
Run the same command again later.
There is no next step, for this reason.

related.description: The diagnostics that the failure's diagnostic relates to it, in the order it gives them. It is present only when there is at least one.

cause.description: The errors below the related diagnostic, joined with ": ". It is present only when there is one.

code.description: The related diagnostic's own code, which is free text. It is present only when the diagnostic has one.

help.description: The related diagnostic's advice. It is present only when it gives some.

related.description: The diagnostics related to this one, in the same shape, to at most eight levels below the failure.

severity.description: How severe the related diagnostic is. A diagnostic that gives no severity is an error.

url.description: A page that explains the related diagnostic. It is present only when it has one.
A page that explains the failure. It is present only when the failure has one.
